description.value: A family-owned motel in Penticton, BC, positioned near the city's wine, music, and festival scene in the Okanagan. As one of the larger motels in Penticton, it offers room types ranging from cozy studios to two-bedroom family suites, most with kitchenette or full kitchen facilities. The property features a heated outdoor saltwater pool and communal courtyard, making it a comfortable base for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan.
